text:
The immediate-after constraints lock two blocks: Hana–Gus–Dev in three consecutive slots, and Finn–Ben in two consecutive slots. The two “exactly one between” constraints with Elif then force Elif two slots after Dev and Finn–Ben two slots after Elif, so the only pattern that fits inside slots 1–9 is:

Hana, Gus, Dev, (open), Elif, Finn, Ben

with Hana starting at slot 2 (starts at 1 or 3 leave no legal slot for Cara once Ann is placed before Elif). The remaining constraints place Ann in the open slot between Dev and Elif, Cara two after Finn, and Ivo in the only slot left before Finn and at least three away from Ann.

CONFIDENCE: 98
